00125 void EnvelopeHandleComponent::updateLegend()
00126 {
00127  String text;
00128  
00129  int width = getParentWidth();
00130  int places;
00131  
00132  if(width >= 165) {
00133   EnvelopeComponent *env = getParentComponent();
00134   
00135   if(env && env->isLoopNode(this))
00136    text << T("(Loop) ");
00137   else if(env && env->isReleaseNode(this))
00138    text << T("(Release) ");
00139   else
00140    text << T("Point ");
00141   
00142   places = 3;
00143  }
00144  else if(width >= 140) {
00145   text << T("Point ");
00146   places = 3;
00147  } else if(width >= 115) {
00148   text << T("Pt ");
00149   places = 3;
00150  } else if(width >= 100) {
00151   text << T("Pt ");
00152   places = 2;
00153  } else if(width >= 85) {
00154   text << T("Pt ");
00155   places = 1;
00156  } else if(width >= 65) {
00157   text << T("P ");
00158   places = 1;
00159  } else {
00160   places = 1;
00161  }
00162  
00163  text << (getHandleIndex())
00164    << T(": ")
00165    << String(time, places) 
00166    << T(", ") 
00167    << String(value, places);
00168  
00169  getParentComponent()->setLegendText(text);
00170 }

00230 void EnvelopeHandleComponent::mouseDown(const MouseEvent& e)
00231 {
00232 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00233  printf("MyEnvelopeHandleComponent::mouseDown (%d, %d)\n", e.x, e.y);
00234 #endif
00235  
00236  setMouseCursor(MouseCursor::NoCursor);
00237  
00238  if(e.mods.isShiftDown()) {
00239   
00240   getParentComponent()->setLegendTextToDefault();
00241   removeThisHandle();
00242   
00243   
00244  } 
00245  else if(e.mods.isCtrlDown())
00246  {
00247   if(getParentComponent()->getAllowNodeEditing())
00248   {
00249    ignoreDrag = true;
00250    
00251    if(PopupComponent::getActivePopups() < 1)
00252    {
00253     EnvelopeNodePopup::create(this, getScreenX()+e.x, getScreenY()+e.y);
00254    }
00255   }
00256  }
00257  else 
00258  {
00259   
00260   offsetX = e.x;
00261   offsetY = e.y;
00262   
00263   resizeLimits.setMinimumOnscreenAmounts(HANDLESIZE,HANDLESIZE,HANDLESIZE,HANDLESIZE);
00264   
00265   EnvelopeHandleComponent* previousHandle = getPreviousHandle();
00266   EnvelopeHandleComponent* nextHandle = getNextHandle();
00267   
00268   int leftLimit = previousHandle == 0 ? 0 : previousHandle->getX()+2;
00269   int rightLimit = nextHandle == 0 ? getParentWidth()-HANDLESIZE : nextHandle->getX()-2;
00270 //  int leftLimit = previousHandle == 0 ? 0 : previousHandle->getX();
00271 //  int rightLimit = nextHandle == 0 ? getParentWidth()-HANDLESIZE : nextHandle->getX();
00272 
00273   
00274   resizeLimits.setAdjacentHandleLimits(leftLimit, rightLimit);
00275 
00276   dragger.startDraggingComponent(this, &resizeLimits);
00277  
00278  }
00279 }

00281 void EnvelopeHandleComponent::mouseDrag(const MouseEvent& e)
00282 {
00283  if(ignoreDrag == true) return;
00284  
00285  if(e.mods.isAltDown()) {
00286 
00287   int moveX = e.x-offsetX;
00288   int moveY = offsetY-e.y;
00289   
00290   offsetTimeAndValue(moveX * FINETUNE, moveY * FINETUNE, FINETUNE);
00291   ignoreDrag = true;
00292   setMousePositionToThisHandle();
00293   ignoreDrag = false;
00294   
00295  } else {
00296     
00297   dragger.dragComponent(this, e);
00298  }
00299  
00300  updateLegend();
00301  getParentComponent()->repaint();
00302  getParentComponent()->sendChangeMessage();
00303  
00304  if(lastX == getX() && lastY == getY()) { 
00305   setMousePositionToThisHandle();
00306 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00307   int x, y;
00308   Desktop::getMousePosition(x, y); 
00309   printf("screen pos (and mouse pos): %d (%d) %d (%d)\n", getScreenX(), x, getScreenY(), y);
00310 #endif 
00311  }
00312 
00313  lastX = getX();
00314  lastY = getY();
00315  
00316 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00317  double domain = getParentComponent()->convertPixelsToDomain(getX());
00318  double value = getParentComponent()->convertPixelsToValue(getY());
00319  printf("MyEnvelopeHandleComponent::mouseDrag(%d, %d) [%f, %f] (%d, %d)\n", e.x, e.y, 
00320      domain,
00321      value,
00322      getParentComponent()->convertDomainToPixels(domain),
00323      getParentComponent()->convertValueToPixels(value));
00324 #endif
00325  
00326 }

00419 void EnvelopeHandleComponent::setTimeAndValue(double timeToSet, double valueToSet, double quantise)
00420 {
00421  bool oldDontUpdateTimeAndValue = dontUpdateTimeAndValue;
00422  dontUpdateTimeAndValue = true;
00423 
00424 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00425  printf("MyEnvelopeHandleComponent::setTimeAndValue original (%f, %f)\n", timeToSet, valueToSet);
00426 #endif
00427  
00428  if(quantise > 0.0) {
00429   int steps;
00430 
00431   steps  = valueToSet / quantise;
00432   valueToSet = steps * quantise;
00433   steps  = timeToSet  / quantise;
00434   timeToSet = steps * quantise;
00435   
00436 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00437   printf("MyEnvelopeHandleComponent::setTimeAndValue quantised (%f, %f)\n", timeToSet, valueToSet);
00438 #endif
00439  }
00440  
00441 // valueToSet = getParentComponent()->quantiseValue(valueToSet);
00442 // timeToSet = getParentComponent()->quantiseDomain(timeToSet);
00443  
00444  value = constrainValue(valueToSet);
00445  time = constrainDomain(timeToSet);
00446  
00447  setTopLeftPosition(getParentComponent()->convertDomainToPixels(time), 
00448         getParentComponent()->convertValueToPixels(value));
00449  
00450  dontUpdateTimeAndValue = oldDontUpdateTimeAndValue;
00451  
00452  getParentComponent()->repaint();
00453  getParentComponent()->sendChangeMessage();

00462 double EnvelopeHandleComponent::constrainDomain(double domainToConstrain) const
00463 { 
00464  EnvelopeHandleComponent* previousHandle = getPreviousHandle();
00465  EnvelopeHandleComponent* nextHandle = getNextHandle();
00466 
00467  int leftLimit = previousHandle == 0 ? 0 : previousHandle->getX();
00468  int rightLimit = nextHandle == 0 ? getParentWidth()-HANDLESIZE : nextHandle->getX();
00469  
00470  double left = getParentComponent()->convertPixelsToDomain(leftLimit);
00471  double right = getParentComponent()->convertPixelsToDomain(rightLimit);
00472  
00473  if(previousHandle != 0) left += FINETUNE;
00474  if(nextHandle != 0) right -= FINETUNE;
00475   
00476  return jlimit(left, right, domainToConstrain); 
00477 }

00628 void EnvelopeComponent::paint(Graphics& g)
00629 {
00630  paintBackground(g);
00631  
00632  if(handles.size() > 0)
00633  {
00634   Path path;
00635   Env env = getEnv();
00636   
00637   EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle = handles.getUnchecked(0);
00638   path.startNewSubPath((handle->getX() + handle->getRight()) * 0.5f,
00639         (handle->getY() + handle->getBottom()) * 0.5f);
00640   
00641   const float firstTime = handle->getTime();
00642   float time = firstTime;
00643   
00644   for(int i = 1; i < handles.size(); i++) 
00645   {
00646    handle = handles.getUnchecked(i);
00647    float halfWidth = handle->getWidth()*0.5f;
00648    float halfHeight = handle->getHeight()*0.5f;
00649    
00650    float nextTime = handle->getTime();
00651    float handleTime = nextTime - time;
00652    float timeInc = handleTime / curvePoints;
00653    
00654    for(int j = 0; j < curvePoints; j++)
00655    {
00656     float value = env.lookup(time - firstTime);
00657     path.lineTo(convertDomainToPixels(time) + halfWidth, 
00658        convertValueToPixels(value) + halfHeight);
00659     time += timeInc;
00660    }
00661    
00662    path.lineTo((handle->getX() + handle->getRight()) * 0.5f,
00663       (handle->getY() + handle->getBottom()) * 0.5f);
00664    
00665    time = nextTime;
00666   }
00667   
00668   g.setColour(colours[Line]);
00669   g.strokePath (path, PathStrokeType(1.0f));
00670   
00671   if((loopNode >= 0) && (releaseNode >= 0) && (releaseNode > loopNode))
00672   {   
00673    EnvelopeHandleComponent* releaseHandle = handles[releaseNode];
00674    EnvelopeHandleComponent* loopHandle = handles[loopNode];
00675    
00676    if((releaseHandle != 0) && (loopHandle != 0))
00677    {
00678     // draw a horizontal line from release
00679     g.setColour(colours[LoopLine]);
00680     
00681     const float loopY = (loopHandle->getY() + loopHandle->getBottom()) * 0.5f;
00682     const float releaseY = (releaseHandle->getY() + releaseHandle->getBottom()) * 0.5f;
00683     const float loopX = (loopHandle->getX() + loopHandle->getRight()) * 0.5f;
00684     const float releaseX = (releaseHandle->getX() + releaseHandle->getRight()) * 0.5f;
00685     
00686     float dashes[] = { 5, 3 };
00687     g.drawDashedLine(loopX, releaseY, 
00688          loopX, loopY, 
00689          dashes, numElementsInArray(dashes), 0.5f);
00690     
00691     const int arrowLength = HANDLESIZE*2;
00692     
00693     g.drawLine(releaseX, releaseY, 
00694          loopX + arrowLength, releaseY, 
00695          0.5f);
00696     
00697     if(loopY == releaseY)
00698      g.setColour(colours[LoopNode]);
00699     
00700 //    g.drawArrow(loopX + arrowLength, releaseY, 
00701 //       loopX, releaseY, 
00702 //       0.5f, HANDLESIZE, arrowLength);
00703     g.drawArrow(juce::Line<float>((float)(loopX + arrowLength), releaseY, loopX, releaseY), 
00704        0.5f, HANDLESIZE, arrowLength);
00705     
00706    }
00707   }
00708  }
00709 }

00712 void EnvelopeComponent::paintBackground(Graphics& g)
00713 {
00714  g.setColour(colours[Background]);
00715  g.fillRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());
00716  
00717  g.setColour(colours[GridLine]);
00718  
00719  if((gridDisplayMode & GridValue) && (valueGrid > 0.0))
00720  {
00721   double value = valueMin;
00722   
00723   while(value <= valueMax)
00724   {
00725    //g.drawHorizontalLine(convertValueToPixels(value) + HANDLESIZE/2, 0, getWidth());
00726    float y = convertValueToPixels(value) + HANDLESIZE/2;
00727    y = round(y, 1.f) + 0.5f;
00728    g.drawLine(0, y, getWidth(), y, 1.0f);
00729    value += valueGrid;
00730   }
00731  }
00732  
00733  if((gridDisplayMode & GridDomain) && (domainGrid > 0.0))
00734  {
00735   double domain = domainMin;
00736   
00737   while(domain <= domainMax)
00738   {
00739    g.drawVerticalLine(convertDomainToPixels(domain) + HANDLESIZE/2, 0, getHeight());
00740    domain += domainGrid;
00741   }
00742  }
00743 }

00745 void EnvelopeComponent::resized()
00746 { 
00747 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00748  printf("MyEnvelopeComponent::resized(%d, %d)\n", getWidth(), getHeight());
00749 #endif
00750  if(handles.size() != 0) {
00751   for(int i = 0; i < handles.size(); i++) {
00752    EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle = handles.getUnchecked(i);
00753    
00754    bool oldDontUpdateTimeAndValue = handle->dontUpdateTimeAndValue;
00755    handle->dontUpdateTimeAndValue = true;
00756       
00757    handle->setTopLeftPosition(convertDomainToPixels(handle->getTime()),
00758             convertValueToPixels(handle->getValue()));
00759    
00760    handle->dontUpdateTimeAndValue = oldDontUpdateTimeAndValue;
00761   }
00762  }

00774 void EnvelopeComponent::mouseDown(const MouseEvent& e)
00775 {
00776 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00777  printf("MyEnvelopeComponent::mouseDown(%d, %d)\n", e.x, e.y);
00778 #endif
00779  
00780  if(e.mods.isShiftDown()) 
00781  {
00782   
00783   // not needed ?
00784     
00785  }
00786  else if(e.mods.isCtrlDown())
00787  {
00788   if(getAllowCurveEditing())
00789   {
00790    float timeAtClick = convertPixelsToDomain(e.x);
00791    
00792    int i;
00793    EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle;
00794    
00795    for(i = 0; i < handles.size(); i++) {
00796     handle = handles.getUnchecked(i);
00797     if(handle->getTime() > timeAtClick)
00798      break;
00799    }
00800    
00801    if(PopupComponent::getActivePopups() < 1)
00802    {
00803     EnvelopeHandleComponent* prev = handle->getPreviousHandle();
00804     
00805     if(!prev)
00806     {
00807      EnvelopeCurvePopup::create(handle, getScreenX()+e.x, getScreenY()+e.y);
00808     }
00809     else
00810     {
00811      EnvelopeCurvePopup::create(handle, 
00812               (handle->getScreenX() + prev->getScreenX())/2, 
00813               jmax(handle->getScreenY(), prev->getScreenY())+10);
00814     }
00815    }
00816   }
00817  }
00818  else 
00819  {
00820   draggingHandle = addHandle(e.x,e.y, EnvCurve::Linear);
00821   
00822   if(draggingHandle != 0) {
00823    setMouseCursor(MouseCursor::NoCursor);
00824    draggingHandle->mouseDown(e.getEventRelativeTo(draggingHandle));
00825    draggingHandle->updateLegend();
00826   }
00827  }
00828 }

00949 EnvelopeHandleComponent* EnvelopeComponent::addHandle(double newDomain, double newValue, EnvCurve curve)
00950 {
00951 #ifdef MYDEBUG
00952  printf("MyEnvelopeComponent::addHandle(%f, %f)\n", (float)newDomain, (float)newValue);
00953 #endif
00954  
00955 // newDomain = quantiseDomain(newDomain);
00956 // newValue = quantiseValue(newValue);
00957  
00958  if(handles.size() < maxNumHandles) {
00959   int i;
00960   for(i = 0; i < handles.size(); i++) {
00961    EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle = handles.getUnchecked(i);
00962    if(handle->getTime() > newDomain)
00963     break;
00964   }
00965   
00966   if(releaseNode >= i) releaseNode++;
00967   if(loopNode >= i) loopNode++;
00968   
00969   EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle;
00970   addAndMakeVisible(handle = new EnvelopeHandleComponent());
00971   handle->setSize(HANDLESIZE, HANDLESIZE);
00972   handle->setTimeAndValue(newDomain, newValue, 0.0); 
00973   handle->setCurve(curve);
00974   handles.insert(i, handle);
00975   sendChangeMessage();
00976   return handle;
00977  }
00978  else return 0;
00979 }

00982 void EnvelopeComponent::removeHandle(EnvelopeHandleComponent* thisHandle)
00983 {
00984  if(handles.size() > minNumHandles) {
00985   int index = handles.indexOf(thisHandle);
00986   
00987   if(releaseNode >= 0)
00988   {
00989    if(releaseNode == index)
00990     releaseNode = -1;
00991    else if(releaseNode > index)
00992     releaseNode--;
00993   }
00994   
00995   if(loopNode >= 0)
00996   {
00997    if(loopNode == index)
00998     loopNode = -1;
00999    else if(loopNode > index)
01000     loopNode--;
01001   }
01002   
01003   handles.removeValue(thisHandle);
01004   removeChildComponent(thisHandle);
01005   delete thisHandle;
01006   sendChangeMessage();
01007   repaint();
01008  }
01009 }

01011 void EnvelopeComponent::quantiseHandle(EnvelopeHandleComponent* thisHandle)
01012 {
01013  ugen_assert(thisHandle != 0);

01016  {
01017   double domain = round(thisHandle->getTime(), domainGrid);
01018   thisHandle->setTime(domain);
01019   
01020  }
01021  
01022  if((gridQuantiseMode & GridValue) && (valueGrid > 0.0))
01023  {
01024   double value = round(thisHandle->getValue(), valueGrid);
01025   thisHandle->setValue(value);
01026  }
01027 }

01107 double EnvelopeComponent::convertPixelsToDomain(int pixelsX, int pixelsXMax) const
01108 {
01109  if(pixelsXMax < 0) 
01110   pixelsXMax = getWidth()-HANDLESIZE;
01111  
01112  return (double)pixelsX / pixelsXMax * (domainMax-domainMin) + domainMin;
01113 
01114 }
01115 
01116 double EnvelopeComponent::convertPixelsToValue(int pixelsY, int pixelsYMax) const
01117 {
01118  if(pixelsYMax < 0)
01119   pixelsYMax = getHeight()-HANDLESIZE;
01120  
01121  return (double)(pixelsYMax - pixelsY) / pixelsYMax * (valueMax-valueMin) + valueMin;
01122 }
01123 
01124 double EnvelopeComponent::convertDomainToPixels(double domainValue) const
01125 {
01126  return (domainValue - domainMin) / (domainMax - domainMin) * (getWidth() - HANDLESIZE);
01127 }
01128 
01129 double EnvelopeComponent::convertValueToPixels(double value) const
01130 { 
01131  double pixelsYMax = getHeight()-HANDLESIZE; 
01132  return pixelsYMax-((value- valueMin) / (valueMax - valueMin) * pixelsYMax);
01133 }
01134 
01135 Env EnvelopeComponent::getEnv() const
01136 {
01137  if(handles.size() < 1) return Env(B(0.0, 0.0), B(0.0));
01138  if(handles.size() < 2) return Env(B(0.0, 0.0), B(handles.getUnchecked(0)->getValue()));
01139  
01140  EnvelopeHandleComponent* startHandle = handles.getUnchecked(0);
01141  double currentLevel = startHandle->getValue();
01142  double currentTime = startHandle->getTime();
01143  
01144  Buffer levels = Buffer::newClear(handles.size());
01145  Buffer times = Buffer::newClear(handles.size()-1);
01146  EnvCurveList curves = EnvCurveList(EnvCurve::Empty, handles.size()-1);
01147  
01148  levels.setSampleUnchecked(0, currentLevel);
01149  
01150  for(int i = 1; i < handles.size(); i++) 
01151  {
01152   EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle = handles.getUnchecked(i);
01153   
01154   currentLevel = handle->getValue();
01155   double time = handle->getTime();
01156   
01157   levels.setSampleUnchecked(i, currentLevel);
01158   times.setSampleUnchecked(i-1, time-currentTime);
01159   curves[i-1] = handle->getCurve();
01160   
01161   currentTime = time;
01162  }
01163  
01164  return Env(levels, times, curves, releaseNode, loopNode);
01165 }
01166 
01167 void EnvelopeComponent::setEnv(Env const& env)
01168 {
01169  double time = 0.0;
01170  
01171  const Buffer& levels = env.getLevels();
01172  const Buffer& times = env.getTimes();
01173  const EnvCurveList& curves = env.getCurves();
01174  
01175  ugen_assert(levels.size() == (times.size()+1));
01176  
01177  EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle = addHandle(time, (double)levels[0], EnvCurve::Linear);
01178  quantiseHandle(handle);
01179 
01180  for(int i = 0; i < times.size(); i++)
01181  {
01182   time += times[i];
01183   handle = addHandle(time, (double)levels[i+1], curves[i]);
01184   quantiseHandle(handle);
01185  }
01186  
01187  releaseNode = env.getReleaseNode();
01188  loopNode = env.getLoopNode();
01189 }
01190 
01191 float EnvelopeComponent::lookup(const float time) const
01192 {
01193  if(handles.size() < 1)
01194  {
01195   return 0.f;
01196  }
01197  else 
01198  {
01199   EnvelopeHandleComponent *first = handles.getUnchecked(0);
01200   EnvelopeHandleComponent *last = handles.getUnchecked(handles.size()-1);
01201   
01202   if(time <= first->getTime())
01203   {
01204    return first->getValue();
01205   }
01206   else if(time >= last->getTime())
01207   {
01208    return last->getValue();
01209   }
01210   else
01211   {
01212    return getEnv().lookup(time - first->getTime());
01213   }
01214  }
01215 }
01216 
01217 void EnvelopeComponent::setMinMaxNumHandles(int min, int max)
01218 {
01219  if(min <= max) {
01220   minNumHandles = min;
01221   maxNumHandles = max;
01222  } else {
01223   minNumHandles = max;
01224   maxNumHandles = min;
01225  }
01226  
01227  Random rand(Time::currentTimeMillis());
01228  
01229  if(handles.size() < minNumHandles) {
01230   int num = minNumHandles-handles.size();
01231   
01232   for(int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
01233    double randX = rand.nextDouble() * (domainMax-domainMin) + domainMin;
01234    double randY = rand.nextDouble() * (valueMax-valueMin) + valueMin;
01235       
01236    addHandle(randX, randY, EnvCurve::Linear);
01237   }
01238   
01239  } else if(handles.size() > maxNumHandles) {
01240   int num = handles.size()-maxNumHandles;
01241   
01242   for(int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
01243    removeHandle(handles.getLast());
01244   }
01245  }
01246  
01247 }

01374 EnvelopeCurvePopup::EnvelopeCurvePopup(EnvelopeHandleComponent* handleToEdit)
01375 : handle(handleToEdit),
01376  initialised(false)
01377 {
01378  resetCounter();
01379  
01380  EnvCurve curve = handle->getCurve();
01381  EnvCurve::CurveType type = curve.getType();
01382  float curveValue = curve.getCurve();
01383  
01384  addChildComponent(slider = new CurveSlider());
01385  slider->setSliderStyle(Slider::LinearBar);
01386  //slider->setTextBoxStyle(Slider::NoTextBox, false, 0,0);
01387  slider->setRange(-1, 1, 0.0);
01388  slider->setValue(curveValue, false);
01389  
01390  
01391  addAndMakeVisible(combo = new ComboBox(T("combo"))); 
01392  combo->addItem(T("Empty"),   idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Empty);
01393  combo->addItem(T("Numerical..."), idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Numerical);
01394  combo->addItem(T("Step"),   idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Step);
01395  combo->addItem(T("Linear"),   idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Linear);
01396  
01397  EnvelopeComponent *parent = handleToEdit->getParentComponent();
01398  double min, max;
01399  parent->getValueRange(min, max);
01400  
01401  if(((min > 0.0) && (max > 0.0)) || ((min < 0.0) && (min < 0.0)))
01402  {
01403   // exponential can't cross zero
01404   combo->addItem(T("Exponential"), idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Exponential);
01405  }
01406  
01407  combo->addItem(T("Sine"),   idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Sine);
01408  combo->addItem(T("Welch"),   idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Welch);
01409  
01410  combo->addListener(this);
01411  
01412  switch(type)
01413  {
01414   case EnvCurve::Empty:  combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Empty,  false); break;
01415   case EnvCurve::Numerical: combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Numerical, false); break;
01416   case EnvCurve::Step:  combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Step,  false); break;
01417   case EnvCurve::Linear:  combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Linear,  false); break;
01418   case EnvCurve::Exponential: combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Exponential, false); break;
01419   case EnvCurve::Sine:  combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Sine,  false); break;
01420   case EnvCurve::Welch:  combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)EnvCurve::Welch,  false); break;
01421  }
01422  
01423  slider->addListener(this);
01424 }

01426 void EnvelopeCurvePopup::create(EnvelopeHandleComponent* handle, int x, int y)
01427 {

01501 EnvelopeNodePopup::EnvelopeNodePopup(EnvelopeHandleComponent* handleToEdit)
01502 : handle(handleToEdit),
01503  initialised(false)
01504 {
01505  resetCounter();
01506  
01507  addChildComponent(setLoopButton = new TextButton(T("Set Y to Loop")));
01508  addChildComponent(setReleaseButton = new TextButton(T("Set Y to Release")));
01509  setLoopButton->addButtonListener(this);
01510  setReleaseButton->addButtonListener(this);
01511  
01512  addAndMakeVisible(combo = new ComboBox(T("combo"))); 
01513  combo->addItem(T("Normal"),   idOffset + (int)Normal);
01514  combo->addItem(T("Release"),  idOffset + (int)Release);
01515  combo->addItem(T("Loop"),   idOffset + (int)Loop);
01516  combo->addItem(T("Release & Loop"), idOffset + (int)ReleaseAndLoop);
01517  combo->addListener(this);
01518  
01519  EnvelopeComponent* env = handle->getParentComponent();
01520  
01521  if(env != 0)
01522  {
01523   if(env->isLoopNode(handle) && env->isReleaseNode(handle))
01524    combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)ReleaseAndLoop, false);
01525   else if(env->isLoopNode(handle))
01526    combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)Loop, false);
01527   else if(env->isReleaseNode(handle))
01528    combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)Release, false);
01529   else
01530    combo->setSelectedId(idOffset + (int)Normal, false);
01531  }
01532  
01533 }

01575 void EnvelopeNodePopup::comboBoxChanged (ComboBox* comboBoxThatHasChanged)
01576 {
01577  resetCounter();
01578  
01579  if(comboBoxThatHasChanged == combo)
01580  {
01581   EnvelopeComponent* env = handle->getParentComponent();
01582   
01583   if(env != 0)
01584   {
01585    NodeType type = (NodeType)(combo->getSelectedId() - idOffset);
01586    
01587    switch(type)
01588    {
01589     case Normal: {
01590      
01591      if(env->isLoopNode(handle)) 
01592       env->setLoopNode(-1);
01593      
01594      if(env->isReleaseNode(handle)) 
01595       env->setReleaseNode(-1);
01596      
01597      setLoopButton->setVisible(false);
01598      setReleaseButton->setVisible(false);
01599      
01600     } break;
01601      
01602     case Release: {
01603      
01604      if(env->isLoopNode(handle)) 
01605       env->setLoopNode(-1);
01606      
01607      env->setReleaseNode(handle);
01608      
01609      setReleaseButton->setVisible(false);
01610      
01611      if(env->getLoopNode() != -1)
01612       setLoopButton->setVisible(true);
01613      
01614     } break;
01615      
01616     case Loop: {
01617      
01618      env->setLoopNode(handle);
01619      
01620      if(env->isReleaseNode(handle)) 
01621       env->setReleaseNode(-1);
01622      
01623      if(env->getReleaseNode() != -1)
01624       setReleaseButton->setVisible(true);
01625      
01626      setLoopButton->setVisible(false);
01627      
01628     } break;
01629      
01630     case ReleaseAndLoop: {
01631      
01632      env->setLoopNode(handle);
01633      env->setReleaseNode(handle);
01634      
01635      setLoopButton->setVisible(false);
01636      setReleaseButton->setVisible(false);
01637      
01638     }
01639    }
01640   }
01641   
01642   if(initialised) expire();
01643   
01644   initialised = true;
01645  }
01646 }

01648 void EnvelopeNodePopup::buttonClicked(Button *button)
01649 {
01650  EnvelopeComponent* env = handle->getParentComponent();
01651  
01652  if(env != 0)
01653  {
01654   if(button == setLoopButton)
01655   {
01656    int loopNode = env->getLoopNode();
01657    
01658    if(loopNode >= 0)
01659    {
01660     EnvelopeHandleComponent *loopHandle = env->getHandle(loopNode);
01661     
01662     if(loopHandle != 0)
01663     {
01664      float value = loopHandle->getValue();
01665      handle->setValue(value);
01666      expire();
01667     }
01668    }
01669   }
01670   else if(button == setReleaseButton)
01671   {
01672    int releaseNode = env->getReleaseNode();
01673    
01674    if(releaseNode >= 0)
01675    {
01676     EnvelopeHandleComponent *releaseHandle = env->getHandle(releaseNode);
01677     
01678     if(releaseHandle != 0)
01679     {
01680      float value = releaseHandle->getValue();
01681      handle->setValue(value);
01682      expire();
01683     }
01684    }
01685    
01686   }
01687  }
01688 }
